mode: Behavioral scenarios; expected outcomes are rubrics, not executed MCP results

evals.prompt: Stage AI is off but a welcome message was sent.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks universal, stage and lead AI gates plus welcome scheduling/incident-time state and treats any bypass as a runtime policy defect, not a Playbook issue.

evals.prompt: Template quick-reply shows Unsupported message type in chat.
evals.expected_output: The skill inspects inbound interactive payload normalization/context and verifies displayed reply/receipt handling instead of changing the template wording blindly.

evals.prompt: Bulk template send returns 400 even though the template is approved.
evals.expected_output: The skill validates exact component/variable/media payload, selected account/WABA and routing; approval alone is not considered sufficient.

evals.prompt: Hosted WhatsApp says connected but queue messages never send.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks gateway callback/session, worker claim, outbound queue and provider/gateway evidence before reconnecting or editing AI.

evals.prompt: A historical synced message arrives after Coexistence connection.
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes history/backfill semantics and does not treat it as a new live customer trigger.
